The '''Daplona River''' was a slow-moving [[river]] that passed through the country surrounding the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Daplona]], on [[Ciutric IV]]. The [[Assault shuttle/Legends|assault shuttle]] used as a decoy by the [[Ysanne Isard (clone)|clone]] of [[Ysanne Isard]] was shot down by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and plunged into the river, [[Death/Legends|killing]] the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Lorrir/Legends|Lorrir]] during the [[Battle of Ciutric]]. <ref name="X-Wing: IR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>
